title: Audit Summary Schema
description: Post-answer validation scoreboard showing which gates passed/failed

CASE_LAW_GATE.description: Whether all case law mentions have matching CITATION_BLOCKs

EVIDENCE_GATE.description: Whether all volatile facts have EVIDENCE_BLOCKs with proper retrieval proof

VISUAL_GATE.description: Whether timeline/process triggers produced DIAGRAM_BLOCKs (N/A if no triggers)

SCHEMA_GATE.description: Whether all blocks conform to declared schemas

SHOWCASE_GATE.description: Whether SHOWCASE_BLOCK is present and valid (only when SHOWCASE_MODE=ON)

CAPABILITY_GATE.description: Whether capability claims are backed by proof (only when capabilities claimed)

UNKNOWN_FIELDS.description: List of registry keys or assertions that could not be verified (output as UNKNOWN)

examples.NOTES: All volatile facts have EVIDENCE_BLOCK; all case mentions have CITATION_BLOCK.
Live fetch unavailable; fees marked UNKNOWN with authoritative source links provided.
